main_text.l: Quàm paterno plusquam affectu, de profectu Tuo sit solicitus, Illustrissimus Socer Tuus, Mæcenas mihi Honoratissimus, non opus est ut ipse suggeram, cùm tot in aprico elucescant Indicia. Civitas super montem posita, non potest occultari; & in conspectiori conditionis sublimitate, vix libentius observantur virtutes, quàm notantur [illegible, ~6 letters]. Satius est autem nunquam cœptis egregiis spem excitasse; quàm constanter non fovisse; quia expectatio Fœneratrix est, cui pacto tempore, nisi ad Assem fiat satis, indignatur statim, & delinquentem postulat injuriarum. Sed ne Præfatio à Textu generosum Tuum Candorem diutius detineat; Tantum addo: Si conculcatis

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side runs across the middle of the column (for example around "Honoratissimus", "non potest" and "cœptis"); it is not transcribed. The signature at the foot left is read as "ij" and is uncertain. No page number or running head is printed. The paragraph continues on the next page, so it is left open at "conculcatis".
